analysis.title: Americas Healthcare: Biotechnology: Script tracker for key launches within our coverage
key_insights: GS tracks weekly script data for major biotech launches for the week ending 11/13, using IQVIA, Symphony and Bloomberg data, and derives implied 4Q sales for each.

ALNY Amvuttra in ATTR-CM: scripts -9%/flat WoW per IQVIA/Bloomberg. Management noted potential ordering volatility in 4Q as hospitals prepare for and adapt to the final 340B rule, likely in November. Implied 4Q sales are tracking in-line to slightly above GSe/consensus.

BIIB Leqembi in early Alzheimer's disease: +16% WoW and +26% MoM per Bloomberg for Leqembi IQLIK and total Leqembi respectively. GS notes early subcutaneous Leqembi momentum is surpassing the velocity of the initial IV launch and looks to full reimbursement in January.

Leqembi IQLIK: GS is awaiting evidence of sustained acceleration following the approval of subcutaneous maintenance and blood-based biomarker tests, expected in 2027 following full reimbursement of Leqembi IQLIK.

GILD Yeztugo in HIV PrEP: scripts +3%/+6% WoW. Per management, more than 70% of users returned for re-injection at six months, implying annual persistency above other PrEP options (daily orals and Apretude at about 50%). Implied 4Q sales are tracking above GSe/consensus.

VRTX Journavx in acute pain: scripts +4%/+5% WoW. Management expects prescriptions to triple YoY. Patient support programs are expected to sunset in mid-2027, after which gross-to-net (GTN) dynamics should normalize. Implied 4Q sales are tracking slightly above GSe/consensus.

MRNA Spikevax and mNEXSPIKE in COVID-19: scripts -19%/-18% WoW. MRNA raised FY revenue guidance to 15-25% YoY growth from up to 10%, which implies a step-down in 4Q revenue. Implied 4Q sales are tracking slightly above GSe/consensus.

AMGN Uplizna in IgG4-related disease and generalized myasthenia gravis: scripts -6% MoM. GS continues to see upside to consensus estimates driven by strong uptake in IgG4-RD and gMG. Implied 4Q sales are tracking in-line with GSe/consensus.

Data caveats: Gilead scripts may not fully capture the buy-and-bill model and are adjusted by a factor of 2 for the oral loading dose. IQVIA/Symphony for MRNA vaccines capture retail/pharmacy scripts only, not shipping or inventory. Symphony Uplizna data counts institutional volume units, with 30 units per patient dose.

market_movers.rationale: Amvuttra ATTR-CM scripts -9%/flat WoW, with possible 4Q ordering volatility from the 340B rule. Implied 4Q sales are in-line to slightly above GSe/consensus.
Leqembi scripts +16% WoW and +26% MoM. Subcutaneous uptake is faster than the initial IV launch, with full reimbursement expected in January.
Yeztugo scripts +3%/+6% WoW, more than 70% re-injection at six months, and implied 4Q sales above GSe/consensus.
Journavx scripts +4%/+5% WoW, with implied 4Q sales slightly above GSe/consensus and prescriptions expected to triple YoY.
COVID vaccine scripts -19%/-18% WoW. FY guidance raised to 15-25% YoY growth implies a 4Q step-down, though implied 4Q sales track slightly above GSe/consensus.
Uplizna scripts -6% MoM, but GS sees upside to consensus from IgG4-RD and gMG uptake. Implied 4Q sales are in-line with GSe/consensus.

sector_views.rationale: The note tracks launch scripts and implied 4Q sales against GSe and consensus and gives no sector-level stance. Most launches track in-line to above estimates.

earnings_insights: ALNY: implied 4Q Amvuttra sales (script-based, IQVIA capture rate) are tracking in-line to slightly above GSe and consensus (estimate comparison, not a reported figure).
GILD: implied 4Q Yeztugo sales are tracking above GSe and consensus (script-based estimate, not reported).
VRTX: implied 4Q Journavx sales are tracking slightly above GSe and consensus (script-based estimate, not reported).
MRNA: implied 4Q COVID vaccine sales are tracking slightly above GSe and consensus. FY revenue guidance was raised to 15-25% YoY growth from up to 10%, implying a step-down in 4Q revenue.
AMGN: implied 4Q Uplizna sales are tracking in-line with GSe and consensus. GS sees upside to consensus estimates over time from IgG4-RD and gMG uptake.
BIIB: no implied 4Q sales given for Leqembi. GS looks to full reimbursement in January.
risk_factors: Final 340B rule, likely in November, may cause ordering volatility in 4Q for Amvuttra as hospitals adapt.
Script data may not capture buy-and-bill dosing (Yeztugo), vaccine shipping and inventory (MRNA), or non-retail blocking in the Leqembi IV segment per Bloomberg.
Journavx patient support programs are expected to sunset in mid-2027, after which GTN dynamics normalize.
